description: This file defines a custom exception class 'RecordNotFoundException' within the OrangeHRM HRM system, specifically under the API v2 exceptions. It extends the base PHP Exception class, providing default message constants for 'record not found' scenarios.

classes.name: RecordNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that a requested record was not found during API operations within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the RecordNotFoundException object, optionally with a custom message, error code, and previous Throwable exception.
